US Energy Secretary Chris Wright says high oil prices are temporary and calls this a "short term interruption" due to the war in Iran. He wouldn't predict where oil prices will go from here, but he says large military forces are being used to get ships through the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: От Газы до Рамаллы палестинцы не видят надежды на голосование Израиля
items.original_title: From Gaza to Ramallah, Palestinians see little hope in Israeli vote
items.rss_summary:
In war-ravaged Gaza and the occupied West Bank, many Palestinians were less focused on who would win Israel's election than on whether anything would really change.  
            Whether Benjamin Netanyahu clings to power with his far-right allies or centrist rival Gadi Eisenkot comes out on top, few see much reason for hope in the Tuesday vote.  
            "We fear these elections could bring an even worse leader," said Huda al-Houli, a displaced resident of Khan Yunis in southern Gaza.
